title: RiskAssessment
description: Decision document written by `faraday-validator evaluate-pr` (Faraday Review Phase 1.7). Deterministic for identical inputs: `evaluated_at` is the single legitimately volatile field, excluded by name in the golden-file comparator. `risk_class` here is the REVIEW classification (green/yellow/red/block) and is distinct from risk-class.schema.json, which is the TR-004 session risk taxonomy (docs/standard/elevated/critical); one authority per contract name (ADR-0001). Green does NOT authorize: in Phase 1 approval_authorized and merge_authorized are false for every class, and all failures resolve to founder_review_required=true (fail closed). ApprovalDecision (approval-decision.schema.json) remains the artifact for the founder's human adjudication.

risk_class.description: Review classification. Matches the founder adjudication label suffixes (faraday/founder-<class>).

blocking_reasons.description: Sorted lexicographically by the producer; a list, never a set (determinism prohibition).

policy_digest.description: canonical.bundle_digest of the evaluated policy bundle.

expected_policy_digest_source.description: Where the pinned expected digest came from. 'absent' always co-occurs with a policy_digest_unpinned Block.

evaluated_contract_minor.description: Which accepted contract minor (N or N-1) the evidence was evaluated under (Ruling 16).

evidence_class.description: Canonical enum: evidence-class.schema.json (kept identical by consumer tests).

evidence_fingerprint.description: canonical digest of the evaluated PullRequestReviewEvidence.
